name: Asian Delight
business_description_schema: Burmese and Asian restaurant in Baltimore, MD. Authentic Myanmar cuisine including tea leaf salad, traditional soups, curries, and Thai-influenced dishes. Dine-in and takeout.
review_pitch: Real reviews from Baltimore diners on Google. Guests highlight the authentic flavors, generous portions, and welcoming service.
owner_bio_paragraphs: Siang brings the flavors of Myanmar to Baltimore's west side. Asian Delight is a family-run restaurant serving authentic Burmese and Southeast Asian cuisine — dishes passed down through generations and prepared fresh daily.

The restaurant has built a loyal neighborhood following, with guests returning for the tea leaf salad, traditional soups, and generous portions that have earned a 4.3-star rating across 85 Google reviews.
